feature: Shared grammar analysis and reviewed local-library growth
behavior: The AI tab, local fallback button and retry use one stable SwiftUI task and observable loading model.
Cancellation does not surface as failure; generation tokens reject stale results and successful analysis is reused.
Registered users call the typed grammar endpoint; compatible server rollback falls back on HTTP 404.
AI produces sentence-specific analysis separately from generic reusable proposals.
Canonical IDs, normalized structural fingerprints, independent semantic review and serialized catalog-revision checks prevent duplicate publication.
Uncertain proposals and proposals reviewed against a changed catalog remain unpublished.
Catalog prompts are bounded; analysis prioritizes relevant rules and independent publication review scans all batches.
Background review retries use distinct attempt operation IDs, stable within each attempt; review costs use the service budget.
Reviewed shared rules persist on PostgreSQL, sync into an atomically saved on-device cache and remain usable offline.

privacy.publicLibrary: Generic rules and newly generated examples only; the source sentence is not a catalog field.
privacy.reviewQueue: Encrypted generic proposal, fingerprints and audit identifiers; no original chat sentence field.

ui.provider: Deterministic Debug fixtures; not a live-provider claim

includes: Encrypted queue to independent review to catalog reuse

static: Backend typecheck, focused ESLint, architecture and build passed
iOS architecture and git diff checks passed

preview.computerUse: Device Hub app tree available but its captured screen is blank; verified native screenshot and targeted XCTest interactions instead.

production.health: API and worker active; readiness status ready; deployment resource observation passed

liveProbe.input: Fixed generic English sentences; synthetic UUID actor without email, identity or login session; locked after verification
liveProbe.knownRule: I have already finished my homework. → present-perfect
liveProbe.newRule: I do appreciate your help. → independently reviewed emphatic do / does / did
liveProbe.reuse: Follow-up analysis returned the same shared canonical ID and learnedPoints for local persistence.
liveProbe.billing: Successful grammar_library_review settled under service scope; normal grammar analyses settled under user scope.

encounteredAndResolved: The first staging archive contained nonportable sparse metadata; extraction stopped before switching service. Portable archives preserved file bytes.

The first independent review had AI_UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE. Attempt-specific idempotency keys fixed the retry lock; the same synthetic job then succeeded on attempt 4. Its original pending usage audit was preserved.

limits: Semantic equivalence is reviewed conservatively; this is not a claim of mathematically infallible AI deduplication.
The simulator preview is an iOS Debug install, not an App Store release.
